nodes.label: Migration Convention
nodes.rationale: Numbered, zero-padded, snake_case migration files after the baseline; applied via Supabase SQL Editor, supabase db push, or psql.

nodes.label: schema.sql As Canonical Baseline
nodes.rationale: schema.sql is the complete current schema and is deliberately not duplicated into migrations/ - one authoritative copy avoids the two drifting apart. A fresh install runs schema.sql alone; numbered files exist only for databases created before a change.

nodes.label: Applied Migrations Are Immutable
nodes.rationale: Once a migration has run on any shared environment it is never edited; it is fixed with a new migration. Migrations are idempotent where practical and wrapped in a transaction, except statements like CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY that cannot run inside one.

nodes.label: Migration 0002 prediction_result_matches_status
nodes.rationale: Makes predictions result columns nullable and adds the CHECK tying them to prediction_status.

nodes.label: Migration 0003 auto_provision_profiles
nodes.rationale: on_auth_user_created trigger provisions a VIEWER profile for every new auth user and backfills existing users.

nodes.label: Migration 0004 prediction_assessment_fields
nodes.rationale: Adds combined-assessment fields on predictions, explanation_source on prediction_explanations and source_rule_id on recommendations.

nodes.label: Adding A Risk Factor Type Is Not A Migration
nodes.rationale: risk_factor_types is a reference table, so a new vocabulary entry is an INSERT rather than a schema change.
